lead_headline: Claude Code 2.1.143 ships three crash surfaces in one release as the tracker fills with red
lead_body: Version 2.1.143 is having a difficult Saturday: background agents are crashing with 'exit 1 before init' on macOS arm64, the agents TUI is unresponsive on Windows Terminal with a mouse-tracking leak leaving orphaned daemons, and the native binary segfaults at startup on Apple Silicon under Bun. Subtler breakages compound the picture — foreground sessions misclassified as background jobs, a goal function stuck in an infinite wait loop, and worktree sessions silently able to edit files in the parent checkout. The sole closure is the cowork session-attachment feature request.
lead_article:
The headline today belongs to Claude Code, and not in a flattering way. Version 2.1.143 is having a rough Saturday: background agents are crashing with "exit 1 before init" on macOS arm64, the agents TUI is fully unresponsive on Windows Terminal with a mouse-tracking leak leaving orphaned daemons behind, and the native binary is segfaulting at startup on Apple Silicon under Bun. That's three distinct crash surfaces in a single release. Layered on top are subtler breakages — interactive sessions misclassified as background jobs so that foreground guards fire incorrectly, a goal function caught in an infinite wait loop, and worktree sessions able to quietly edit files in the parent checkout with nothing to stop them. The one closure in the tracker is the cowork session-attachment feature request, which was resolved today, though it's easy to miss against that volume of red.

Everywhere else the day is quiet. AI SDK shipped six commits concentrated in the early morning: the xai provider now dedupes reasoning-start events on multi-summary-part responses, which was producing 400 errors on continuations, and full error detail from xai is now surfaced in APICallError.message rather than swallowed. Both fixes were backported to v6. Astro has one open PR adding a .dev.vars file association to the VS Code extension so it renders as a .env file — small, sensible. Hydrogen closed a MiniOxygen install error. Everything else is holding at quiet.
